title: sok and numbers: a singular noun

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian counts and measures with a singular noun: *sok könyv* (many books), *három szék* (three chairs), *tíz ember* (ten people). The idea of 'more than one' is already in *sok* or the number, so the noun does not repeat it. The verb stays singular too: *Sok könyv van itt.* To ask how many, use *hány*: *Hány szék van itt?*
In English 'many people' needs a plural noun, but *sok ember* keeps *ember* singular. Resist the urge to say *sok emberek*; native speakers will notice right away.
